responsibility: This definition module declares the GNU Modula-2 SYSTEM interface used by the coroutine libraries on native hosts. Besides compiler-provided low-level types and builtins such as ADDRESS, ADR, SHIFT, ROTATE, THROW, and TBITSIZE, it defines the PROCESS record abstraction and the public coroutine/interrupt primitives TRANSFER, NEWPROCESS, IOTRANSFER, LISTEN, ListenLoop, and TurnInterrupts, along with multiword set shift/rotate helper routines that the compiler may call at runtime for non-word-sized BITSET operations.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface specification for the coroutine SYSTEM module: it publishes the PROCESS abstraction, compiler-visible builtins and declarations for TRANSFER, NEWPROCESS, IOTRANSFER, ListenLoop, TurnInterrupts, and the set shift/rotate helpers, while leaving the native-host runtime binding details to SYSTEM.mod.
